C1739.title: Auxiliary Police Officer Convicted for Trafficking Citizens' Personal Information
C1739.summary: A woman in Gansu spent 20,000 yuan to hire someone to investigate her husband's affair, inadvertently exposing an auxiliary police officer who exploited his position to traffic citizens' personal information. The officer and two others were convicted for illegally obtaining and selling personal data.

references.title: ...Investigating Husband's Affair! Unexpectedly Uncovers Auxiliary Police 'Mole'! Three Sentenced for Selling Citizens' Personal Information!
